title: Cho–Choi–Park independent-domination conjecture, even case
statement: If an isolate-free finite graph G on n vertices has even maximum degree D, then (D+2)²i(G)≤(D²+4)n, where i(G) is its independent domination number.

counterexample.description: An isolate-free finite simple graph of even maximum degree for which exact minimization of independent dominating sets violates the stated inequality.
